text:
The independent **European Commission JRC 2020 forest map** identifies forest across 98% of the area where Hansen mapped 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021. A later year was also observed, satisfying the method’s corroboration rule.

Uruguay’s **MGAP 2021 forest map** provides additional context: it maps 68.1 hectares of the loss area as planted pine forest, 13.2 hectares outside mapped forest, and none as native forest.

The JRC map corroborates the pre-loss forest cover, not the cause of the loss. The evidence does not establish deforestation, land-use change, legality or responsibility.
